title: Order Matters: Learning Element Ordering for Graphic Design Generation

context_summary: This paper introduces a model called Generative Order Learner (GOL) to learn optimal element ordering for graphic design generation. The model uses an autoregressive generator and an ordering network to improve the quality of generated designs. The study compares different ordering strategies and shows that the neural order significantly improves visual quality and layout variations.
